# @eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte

Svelte 5 components for the EONA-X design system. **This package is generated.** The
source of truth is the Yew crate in this repository (`src/`): each component was produced by
rendering the Rust component with Yew's own server renderer and splicing the props back
into the resulting markup — the same tree `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-react` is written from.

Generated from src_hash `6b5e166285546e8f773e7e24b49871d2b541213a89ce5a23b7ce030199f90c36`. 41 components exported.

## Two entry points

| Import | What it is | WebAssembly |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte` | the generated components, as `.svelte` | none |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte/wasm` | `<YewMount>` and `use:yew`, to mount a Yew component compiled to WASM | yours, loaded on demand |

Use the first for everything it exports: it server-renders, it tree-shakes, and its markup
is Yew's. Reach for the second only for a component the generator cannot reach — an
interactive one, which lives outside this crate — and accept its cost: one component over a
WASM bridge was measured at 74,593 B gzip against 112 B pre-rendered, it renders nothing
on the server, and a CSP must allow `wasm-unsafe-eval`.

```sh
npm install @eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import '@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css';
  import { Button, Pill } from '@eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte';
</script>

<div class="eona-ui">
  <Button label="Explore" />
  <Pill>Mobility</Pill>
</div>
```

`@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css` comes with this package, at the same version. Every rule in it is scoped under
`.eona-ui`, so render the components inside an element with that class; it then touches
nothing else on the page.

A Rust `Children`/`Html` prop is a Svelte 5 `Snippet`: pass `children` as element content
and any other slot (`ShapeCard`'s `demo`) as a `{#snippet}`.

### Mounting a Yew component

The crate you mount from exports one function, `mount(target, component, props)`, built with
`wasm-bindgen` and Yew's `csr` feature; `examples/svelte-wasm` in the toolkit repository is a
working one.

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { YewMount } from '@eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte/wasm';
  const load = () => import('my-yew-widgets').then(async (m) => (await m.default(), m));
</script>

<YewMount module={load} component="Counter" props={{ start: 3 }} />
```
